rules.rule: Count accepted identity IDs once. Families, systems, segments and individual currents are distinct catalogue entries, not equivalent physical measurement targets.

Count each admitted scoped width-row ID once. Preserve its source, operator, layer, location, date and evidence class. An admitted scoped record does not establish a representative whole-current width.
Count distinct current_id owners of admitted width rows. Do not transfer rows to a parent family or related current, and do not count a candidate series as an admitted width row.

The historical scoped_width dashboard capability also includes derived candidates and some diagnostics. Report it separately from admitted width-record owner coverage; it is not an accepted-measurement completeness score.

An identity with a positive dashboard width capability but zero admitted width rows retains an admitted-record gap. Preserve its candidate-review status until its measurement definition and scientific admission gates pass.

For the inventory status summary, an identity with its own admitted width-row IDs is scoped_width_evidence_present. Otherwise preserve its unresolved decision class. Separate pending candidates can coexist with admitted records.
Count reported whole-current lengths separately from editorial reference routes and regional reaches. Their union is an identity coverage measure, not a count of measured whole-current axes.
Keep seasonal variability, spatial ranges, editorial sensitivity, strict bounds and measurement uncertainty separate. None supplies missing annual extrema or a confidence interval automatically.
